seriesName: Server procurement/shipment growth: US hyperscale cloud providers vs. global market (QoQ)
notes: All four figures come from one BigGo Finance article (itself summarizing a DIGITIMES report, id 20260814RS400, which is paywalled and was excluded as a citable source). The 2Q26 figures (11.6%, 3.8%) are reported actuals; the 3Q26 figures (1.7%, 2.8%) are explicitly labelled as forecasts by the source, not actuals -- flag this on the chart. Presented as a comparison pair: US hyperscale CSP procurement growth vs. the broader global server shipment growth rate, each across the same two quarters, to show the sharper deceleration hitting large cloud providers specifically.
